JOSEPH W. STEVENS’ NOTICE OF ERRORS IN APPLICANTS' PROPOSED ORDER

    OF PRESENTATION AND REOUEST FOR CORRECTION AT PREHEARING

                                    CONFERENCE

                                   I. INTRODUCTION

On June 3,2026, Applicants filed their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing

Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 (Item No. 5755), attaching as

Attachment 2 a proposed order of presentation grouping intervenors by route segment.

Intervenor Joseph W. Stevens files this notice to identify a confirmed placement error

that directly affect him. Mr. Stevens requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct

Applicants to correct Attachment 2 at or before the Prehearing Conference scheduled

for June 8, 2026.

                       II. ERRORS REQUIRING CORRECTION

                                       Stevens Notice of Errors in Proposed Order of Presentation
                                                                          PUC Docket No. 59475
                                                                  SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349
                                                                                      Page 1 of 3
 Attachment 2, page 19, places Intervenor Joseph W. Stevens at Link C4 but not at D12,

with a "First Link" designation of C4. Mr. Stevens’ Motion to Intervene (Item Nos. 3845

and 3824) identifies his opposition as Links C4 and D12. His home property at 7726 FM

2268 Holland, Texas 76534 is located in the Bell County corridor served by Link D12.

His 191-acre farm property near 12981-13699 E. Travis Road, Holland, Texas 76534 is

located in the Bell County corridor served by Link C4. Mr. Stevens should be placed in

the D12 group as his “First Link” in addition to the C4 group, consistent with his Motion

to Intervene and his docket registration as the D12 group represents his primary

residence.

                               III. REQUEST FOR RELIEF

Mr. Stevens respectfully requests that the Administrative Law Judges direct Applicants

to correct Attachment 2 to: (1) place Joseph W. Stevens in the D12 group consistent

with Item Nos. 3845 and 3824 and (2) review segment placements for accuracy and

correct any additional errors identified by other parties or by the presiding officers before

the Hearing on the Merits commences on June 8,2026.




Respectfully Submitted

Joseph Stevens

7726 FM 2268

Holland, TX 76534

512-591-4309
